message.content: I have annual revenue for FY2018–FY2024. Let me compute the growth rates.

**Palantir Technologies Inc. (CIK 1321655) — revenue trend, FY2018–FY2024**

Using the consolidated annual revenue tag `RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax` (USD, full-year periods ending 31 December), revenue rose every year in the period, from $742.6 million in FY2019 to $2,865.5 million in FY2024 — an increase of about 286% over five years (calculated). FY2018 revenue was $595.4 million.

| Fiscal year | Revenue (USD) | YoY growth (calculated) |
|---|---|---|
| FY2018 | 595,409,000 | — |
| FY2019 | 742,555,000 | — |
| FY2020 | 1,092,673,000 | +47.2% |
| FY2021 | 1,541,889,000 | +41.1% |
| FY2022 | 1,905,871,000 | +23.6% |
| FY2023 | 2,225,012,000 | +16.7% |
| FY2024 | 2,865,507,000 | +28.8% |

**Shape of the trend:** growth was strongest in FY2020–FY2021 (roughly 41–47% per year), decelerated sharply through FY2022 and FY2023 (to 23.6% and then 16.7%, the slowest rate in the period), and then re-accelerated in FY2024 to 28.8%. So the overall direction is unambiguously upward in absolute dollars, but the growth *rate* followed a decelerate-then-reaccelerate pattern rather than a steady one.

**Sources (each fact paired with its own filing):**
- FY2018 $595,409,000 and FY2019 $742,555,000: fact IDs 1587060 and 1587061, 10-K filed 2021-02-26, accession 0001193125-21-060650.
- FY2020 $1,092,673,000: fact ID 1587068, 10-K filed 2021-02-26, accession 0001193125-21-060650 (repeated identically in later 10-Ks, e.g. ID 1587070, accession 0001321655-23-000011).
- FY2021 $1,541,889,000: fact ID 1587081, 10-K filed 2022-02-24, accession 0001193125-22-050913.
- FY2022 $1,905,871,000: fact ID 1587094, 10-K filed 2023-02-21, accession 0001321655-23-000011.
- FY2023 $2,225,012,000: fact ID 1587107, 10-K filed 2024-02-20, accession 0001321655-24-000022.
- FY2024 $2,865,507,000: fact ID 1587117, 10-K filed 2025-02-18, accession 0001321655-25-000022.

**Notes and limitations:** The figures are as reported (not adjusted or constant-currency), consolidated, and exclude any segment/geographic dimension breakdown. The database also contains later quarterly data (through Q2 2025, e.g. $1,887.6 million for the six months ended 2025-06-30, fact ID 1587119), which is not comparable to the annual figures above and was not used. The FY2019 YoY growth is not shown because FY2018 is the first year in the retrieved series and the FY2018 figure comes from a comparative column of the FY2020 10-K.
